quote.text: How do I organise a multi-stop trip without a spreadsheet

promise.text: Plan a multi-stop trip without a spreadsheet

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "trip", "stop"

lines.text: Keep transport, nights and reservations in one chronological record, with local dates, realistic buffers and the bookings each change may affect.

items.text: Assign each stop a name and its arrival, departure and overnight dates.
Give every confirmed reservation its own line; keep ideas in a separate section.
Record the actual provider, booking channel and confirmation reference.
Add local start and end times, exact terminals or stations where relevant, and check-in windows.
Note cancellation or change deadlines with the applicable time zone.
Write the nearby bookings that require checking if this one changes.

line.text: Destinations, bookings, travellers and documents in one place, with the shape of the trip held for you rather than in your head.

title.text: Plan a multi-stop trip without a spreadsheet
